story: I landed in Edinburgh on the morning of July 2 for a friend's wedding and my checked bag did not. Skylark Airways delivered it to my hotel the following afternoon, a little over 31 hours later. In between I had a welcome dinner to go to, and I would rather not have attended it in the T-shirt from the airline's amenity kit, so I bought a dress, underwear and basic toiletries. The receipts and the airline's report are attached.
